notes.title: V1.8.1 Mini update
notes.notes:
*With the help of volunteers, we have proofread the English text.
*We have adjusted the balance of some decks and cards. For more details, please check Discord.

notes.title: V1.7.5： Mini update
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: V1.4.7: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added the function to abandon a match during an online match.
*Fixed a problem that may have caused network errors.
*Fixed a bug that caused the freeze when a specific card was copied.
*Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: V1.7.3: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Fixed a bug that sometimes could not play "Windfall" after "Distrortion" even if it fulfill the condition.
*Fixed a bug that "Copy" sometimes doesn't copy "Distortion" correctly.

notes.title: V1.7.2: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Nerf "Omega".
*New card "Cut Out" is added to "Tag Match" deck.
*Balance update "Special" and "TagMatch" deck.
*Balance update "B" deck in custom.

notes.title: V1.7.1: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Change "Transmogrifier" to "Black Box" in the "Specials" deck.
*"All Shuffle" and "Backpass" are back as custom cards.
*Changed the UI of custom functions to make them easier to use.

notes.title: V1.6.3: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added Full Screen mode.
*Fixed a bug that "Mysterious Ruin" sometimes did not trigger even if it fulfill the conditions.

notes.title: V1.6.2: Mini Update
notes.notes: Changed the activation condition for the field "Heavy Storm" from "at the end of the turn" to "after the player passes their turn".

notes.title: V1.6.1: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added "Clockworks" and "Star Compass" to the "Highlander" deck.
*Balance-updated the "Chaos", "Expert" and "Tag Match" deck.

notes.title: V1.5.2: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added specification "When all players have the maximum number of cards in their hands, they can play their card regardless of the shape of the cards.
*Fixed some texts.
*Fixed that rooms with 0 players are not displayed in the lobby.

notes.title: V1.5.1: Mini update
notes.notes:
*Fixed a bug that the game did not launch correctly on Mac (with M1 or M2 chip).
*Fixed a bug that "Trash" didn't transform into "Treasure" when it passed by effect of "Wormhole".
*Removed the specification "When the hand has the maximum number of cards, the player can play the hand regardless of the shape of the cards."

notes.title: V1.4.8:Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Modified to alert sound when the time limit is less than 3 seconds.
*Modified to display a caution mark when "Jail" or "Fanfare" are in play space.
*Fixed UI proportions to make card text easier to read.
*Fixed other minor bubs.

notes.title: V1.4.7:Mini Update
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug that round sometimes don't start in online match.
・Fixed a bug that "Surprise Box" crash game in certain conditon.
・Removed "Clockworks" and added "Pupa" and "Everstone" in expert deck.

notes.title: V1.4.6: Mac version is released!
notes.notes:
*Mac version is now released!
*Balance updated for some decks.

notes.title: V1.4.5: Mini Update
notes.notes:
・Updated to change the Play Time Limit in online match.
・Updated "Basic" deck.
・Updated other minor bugs.

notes.title: V1.4.4: Balance Update
notes.notes:
*Removed "Punch Hole", "Salvation" and "Jugement", added "Flea Market", "Justice" and "Draw1".
* Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: V1.4.3: Update Highlander!
notes.notes:
*The "Highlander" deck was changed from a 60-cards deck to a deck with one of every card type.
*"Jackpot" wes removed and "Omamori" was added in "Tag Match" deck.

notes.title: V1.4.2: Mini update
notes.notes:
*Fixed a bug that game sometimes stops at the beginning of a round in online matchs.
*Adjust the balance of each deck.
*Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: V1.4.1: Mini Update
notes.notes: *Modified "Tag Match" deck, since it was too complicated.

notes.title: V1.3.3: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*"Phoenix", "Golden Apple" and "Chalice" have been updated!
*Changed to make it easier to see whose turn it is now during the game.

notes.title: V1.3.2: Mini Update
notes.notes:
*Added new emotes!
*Added new tips!
*”Phoenix Egg” and "Treasure Map" have been adjusted to be more powerful!
*Fixed other minor bugs and text message.

notes.title: V1.3.1: Mini update
notes.notes:
*Update some cards' text.
*Modified the deck list of some decks.
*Changed to check the game version.

notes.title: 2022/11/17th Update!
notes.notes:
Added chat function in matching room.
Modified to owner can change the game rule in matching room.
Added new score limit type "2 Rounds".
